summary: GigaMedia Limited filed a Form 6-K under Rule 13a-16 or 15d-16, reporting the results of its Annual General Meeting held on June 25, 2026. The filing is a routine foreign private issuer update, not a special situation. All five resolutions—adoption of audited financial statements, appointment of auditors, director remuneration, authority to allot shares, and a share purchase mandate—were passed by ordinary vote. This non-U.S. filing serves as an equivalent to a periodic or current report under the U.S. Securities Exchange Act of 1934. No transaction, restructuring, or corporate event of the targeted types occurred. What to watch: none; this is a standard governance disclosure.
